humanSource.request: Continue the next large M0 outcomes; do not repeat completed checks; preserve existing screens.

scope: Original #521 criteria 1–10, current evidence reconciliation, feature disposition and inactive M1/M2 contracts. This pack does not accept or close M0.

criteria.original: Headless two-sheet workbook: typed inputs, A1/absolute/relative/mixed and cross-sheet references, SUM/IF, insertion/deletion/range boundaries and copy versus cut/move; one authoritative AST record.
criteria.finding: Actual Core, Formula and independent adverse tests cover these operations. Cell-content relocation is supported. It is distinct from general axis move.
limits: SUM/IF and declared arithmetic/coercion/date profile only.
Partial/nonrectangular referenced-range cut refuses before mutation; no general concurrent cut acceptance.

criteria.original: Independent replicas/sessions converge under concurrent row/column insertion, deletion versus formulas and same-cell alternatives without duplicate IDs, invalid structure or revived references.
criteria.finding: Actual Yjs SheetReplica and Core arrival permutations retain atomic inputs, alternatives and tombstones. Separate real-account browser evidence is additional bounded evidence.
limits: No full 10k-provider or UI capacity claim.
Document validity and replica convergence are separate assertions.

criteria.original: Current-session undo preserves remote content, including A inserts a row, B edits it, A undoes insertion; define a recoverable structural conflict.
criteria.finding: The structural case returns recoverable UNDO_CONFLICT and preserves B's value. Session-local cell Undo preserves remote contributions.
limits: Structural safety refusal is not a successful row-removal claim.
Reload starts a new Undo session; durable Undo history is not implemented.

criteria.original: Prose sample covers concurrent same-paragraph text, marks, split/join; define/test move/delete policy before support, without snapshot character sync.
criteria.finding: Real Y.Text characters/newlines, bold/italic/underline, relative anchors and origin-scoped Undo are tested. Paragraph move/delete explicitly refuse.
limits: No complete Note block codec, stable named blocks, nesting, lists, tables or embeds.
The refusal policy is complete for M0; the refused features are not implemented.

criteria.original: Separate local apply/sync/durable save; COMMIT then ACK loss, exact retry, server restart/reconstruction; viable current-access and engine/schema/version server boundary.
criteria.finding: Disposable SQLite and real child-process recovery are tested. Later controlled WS and genuine local account/OIDC/PG receipts add current-ACL/revocation, exact packet retry and same-store NEW-PID recovery.
limits: Account recovery used manual Retry; automatic reconnect/backoff is not proven.
Unapplied draft retention is original hidden/inert page DOM, not browser-close draft persistence.
No backup/restore, hardware power-loss, production migration or asset-lifecycle acceptance.

criteria.original: General concurrent row/column move and overlapping merge may remain refused with explicit M3 semantics; check single-user copy/cut/move references now.
criteria.finding: row.move, column.move and merge return UNSUPPORTED; their refusal leaves native data intact. FormulaTransformHook handles supported atomic cell relocation independently.
limits: General moves/merges, Sheet rename/delete and Sheet redo are not supported.
Future M3 semantics and checks must be scoped before adding these operations.

criteria.original: Redistributable DOCX/XLSX/PPTX fixtures; truthful import/export, unsupported preservation/refusal and original retention; typed/date/formula/reference XLSX probe and separately identified reader.
criteria.finding: Four CC0 fixtures and original bytes remain fixed. Bounded DOCX body/table round trip and separately identified Microsoft Office 16.114 reads exist. The new feature disposition manifest makes loss and unavailable adapters explicit.
limits: DOCX numbering/image/header/footer/footnote export loss remains FAIL for those features.
Product XLSX/PPTX exchange is unavailable/unverified, not a tested refusal or product read-only workflow.
Cached spreadsheet values do not prove recalculation after edit.
Artifact original-byte retention does not prove a product original-retention or lossy-new-copy UX.

criteria.original: Word100/300 layout/print and Sheet10k rows/100cols/50k populated/10k formulas on a named model/reference; frozen budgets, fonts/hardware/browser, raw samples and percentile/memory boundaries.
criteria.finding: Current Word100 RSS 494.59375/491.1875/459.65625MiB and Word300 804.296875/807.859375/804.015625MiB meet frozen limits; original timing/font/repeatability/node-growth gates pass. Sheet headless reference meets all frozen gates.
limits: Word RSS is 200ms sampled owned aggregate including shared pages, not private bytes or continuous HWM.
Three samples give coarse nearest-rank p95/worst-of-three, not a population tail or causal per-fix improvement.
Sheet benchmark excludes provider/Canvas/scroll/keystroke-to-paint capacity.

criteria.original: Versioned decision pack: supported/refused operations, data/checkpoint schemas, binding choice, first failures, risks, budgets and exact M1/M2 interface/ownership split.
criteria.finding: This versioned pack includes current criteria, source/evidence bindings, file capability dispositions, preserved historical failures and exact inactive #528/#529 destinations.
limits: Whole-M0 acceptance remains Planner-owned.
Final Slides repair disposition and final integration/ancestry receipt are separate pending owner inputs, not invented evidence.

criteria.original: Label controlled actor/provider probes separately; M1/M2 actual Office login/two accounts/current ACL/durable reopen/re-edit is not inferred from prototypes.
criteria.finding: Native controlled, WS controlled, and actual configured local OIDC/PG/two-account results are separately identified. Extra local account evidence does not accept common M1/M2 product integration.
limits: No M1/M2 implementation activated, alpha/release/deployment or account/operator/backup/install acceptance.
Physical OS IME, screen reader, true BFCache and target UI scale remain separate product checks.

architecture.decision: Keep the in-house native Sheet event/typed-AST model. Retain Yjs 13.6.29 as the demonstrated low-level primitive; do not adopt a spreadsheet SDK or old generic snapshot adapter.
architecture.authority: WorkbookEvent + WorkbookContext are authoritative. WorkbookProjection, displayed formula text, calculation cache and viewport are derived. Uncommitted drafts and pending original packets are retained user intent, not independent document writers; they cannot be reconstructed or confirmed from a projection or late ACK. Valid refused/pending events remain in history.
architecture.identity: Stable sheet/row/column IDs, tombstones, causal dependencies/frontier and deterministic event-ID ordering; no wall-clock conflict winner or ID reuse.
nativeSchema: WorkbookContext(documentId, workbookId, generation, contractVersion, engineVersion, schemaVersion, adapterVersion)
WorkbookEvent(context:WorkbookContext, eventId, actorId, sessionId, dependencies, command)
persistenceSchema: Checkpoint exact included frontier/IDs + native payload/hash; replay checkpoint then accepted tail with original identities
architecture.wire: SHEET_RELAY_PROTOCOL=1, /api/sheet-relay/v1; explicit current-account binding and per-original-update receipt. Browser does not import the Node store.
refused: Prose paragraph move/delete and unsupported native structures
Snapshot replacement of collaborative native content
Incompatible engine/schema/adapter/generation or unauthorized original retry
remainingRisks: Native revision/full replay and wide frontier scale beyond measured model
1MB Sheet packet / 8MB disposable state and finite retained identity limits
Complete Note block mapping, migration/compaction/retention and hostile-parser resource isolation
Common runtime, durable assets, backup/isolated restore, operational and release gates
Known DOCX losses and unavailable product XLSX/PPTX adapters

m1.dependency: Planner M0 decision and exact accepted adoption/source map

owners.contract: Lifecycle/admission, current identity/generation/versions, truthful save states, read-only projections and retirement.
Adopt exact Core source map and retain stable IDs, alternatives, tombstones, Undo/refusals and frozen model budgets.
Adopt parser/reference/calculation source with one typed AST and explicit freshness/coercion/date/function limits.
Trusted session/current ACL, domain admission, native PostgreSQL transactions/receipts/checkpoints, exact retry and revocation. No caller-granted actor or second authority.
Single registration/migration/runtime writer; record narrower existing-file leases, legacy snapshot exclusion, isolated DB and backup/restore boundary.
Same-candidate actual OIDC/API/PG/two-account save/reopen/re-edit, negative authority, ACK/restart/restore and source-bound evidence.

m2.dependency: Accepted M0 and M1 source/receipts; named initial Note profile

owners.contract: Canvas viewport/overscan, DOM input/IME, selection/clipboard and semantic accessibility from the sole native model.
Versioned complete declared Note codec/binding; unsupported legacy structures explicitly retained read-only/original or conversion refused.
Shared document lifecycle, native Save/Open/re-edit, pending/error and asset capabilities.

owners.role: Execute Sheet Core / Execute Formula / Execute Collaboration
paths: Their activated M1 owned packages and service interfaces
owners.contract: Supported native commands, copy/cut/references/freshness, granular transport, per-session history/anchors/current ACL and receipts.
One route/product registration writer; preserve existing products and authority.
Real same-candidate Sheet/Note two-account journeys, durable reopen/re-edit, denial/recovery, Canvas/input/accessibility; physical IME separately labeled.

M3: General Sheet move/merge policy and implementation
Declared larger function/date/error profile and XLSX
M4: Declared DOCX/PPTX round trips and loss handling

nextStages.activationRule: These are the current #528/#529 planned paths, not new write leases. Planner must record actual owners, exact base/interfaces and acceptance before production work. Existing local account proof can be reused only for unchanged scope; it does not waive M1/M2 missing journeys.

pendingOwnerInputs: Slides owner disposition of the separately assigned UI/connector baseline failures
wholeM0.recommendation: Review original criteria with their explicit support/refusal/measurement limits. Do not re-run valid PASS, promote full-feature losses to PASS, or add full M3/M4 implementation as an unstated M0 gate.
